BiblicalUsage: The word names darkness, gloom, and Isaiah uses it once, for the people who look to the earth and see only trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish, and are driven to darkness. The land itself goes dark for those who will not look up.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the darkness Isaiah names is what happens when men look down instead of up, and the earth gives back only what they brought to it.
